title_zh: 莱基港：西非第一座深水港
title_en: China's Ports (15/20): Lekki, West Africa's First Deepwater Port
note_en: In formal Chinese, 以 + verb at the start of a second clause expresses purpose, like English "in order to": 莱基港未来计划进一步扩建码头和仓储设施，以应对不断增长的货运需求 "plans to further expand its berths and warehousing to meet growing demand." Unlike English, the purpose clause cannot come first with 以; it always follows the action it explains (compare 以保障往来船舶的航行安全 "to keep passing ships safe").
